statement: Producer finite controller-private coefficient controls: for the rank-one 3-by-2 matrix over F5, all 125 coefficient-tag vectors give exactly 25 zero denominators and 100 correct known-secret candidates with a tag-blind kernel. An explicit tag-dependent nonzero kernel annihilates the denominator for all 125 tags. Separate full-column-rank and rank-one fixtures use actual Curve25519 arithmetic and its standard scalar modulus; all group rows and the final known-secret scalar 1234567 are checked. These are finite correctness controls, not an unknown DLP solve, a proof of the generic independence statement, a subquadratic solver, or a sparse-linear-algebra performance measurement. The control elimination is dense/cubic and capped at dimension 64.
